name: SDF Alpha Computation
definition: Computes the output alpha for a Signed Distance Field (SDF) given the Screen Space Ratio (SSR), Signed Distance (SD), Signed Distance Ratio (SDR), isoPerimeter (dilation/contraction), and softness.
summary: SDF Alpha Computation calculates output alpha from signed distance and screen space ratio, distinguishing itself via iso-perimeter and softness parameters for edge blending.
